exposure: Labor room (LR) size, count, and configuration
Operating room (OR) size, count, and configuration
outcome: Correlation between L&D unit design features and clinical outcomes
finding: Significant heterogeneity in L&D unit design was observed across hospitals, and certain design features (e.g., larger unit size, higher LR and OR counts) were modestly correlated with increased cesarean section rates.
mod_finding: Certain L&D unit design features were modestly correlated with increased cesarean section rates.
